page.notes: The right-margin note is printed in two lines, "Chrysosto-" and "mus.", and is transcribed as one note. No reference mark is visible in the text beside it. The signature "D s" is partly obscured and is doubtful. The words "crediturïs" and "crediturs" are doubtful readings of "crediturus"; the printed spelling has been kept as far as it can be read.
